text:
Michael T.: FYI planning a minor version bump from v2.15 -> v2.16. Need to lock down merge + deploy windows that are timezone-friendly for US / EU / APAC. Proposed: 2026-02-12 02:00-04:00 UTC for merges + canary, APAC warmup at 2026-02-12 15:30-17:00 UTC. Thoughts? :calendar: @oncall-sre please confirm SLOs for those windows.
Jen L.: tagging analytics — the events migration lands on 2/12 morning PST, worried about overlap. Can we shift merges earlier by 1h?
Nora: +1 on avoiding overlap with events migration. What about splitting: merges 01:00-03:00 UTC (US/EU focused), then APAC push at 14:00-15:30 UTC? That gives a safety buffer.
Michael T.: I like split. Two concrete cutoffs: branch freeze at 2026-02-12 00:30 UTC (no more merges to release/*), final changelog PR by 2026-02-12 00:45 UTC. APAC-only updates allowed until 12:30 UTC with sign-off.
Pete (platform): I'll own the release branch and will run the merge checklist. Remind folks to: 
```
# create release branch
git checkout -b release/v2.16
git push origin release/v2.16
# cherry-pick urgent fixes to release/v2.16
git checkout release/v2.16
git cherry-pick <commit>
git push origin release/v2.16
```
Also put "DO NOT SQUASH" on any cross-service changelog commits.
Jen L.: Can we get a changelog template reminder? I'll paste one into the release PR description. Also please add migration notes for analytics in the PR body.
Michael T.: Changelog template reminder: short summary, affected services, migration notes (if any), rollback steps. Example bullet list in PR body is fine.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: release/v2.16 canary at 2026-02-12T01:10:00Z in us-central1 (10% traffic). Notifying oncall.
oncall-sre: I'll be oncall for the 01:00-03:00 UTC window. If canary shows >1% error bump I'll pause and ping infra. Also request a quick smoke run: `/run smoke-tests release/v2.16` after canary.
Nora: Quick heads-up: QA will start smoke at 01:25 UTC and regression at 02:00 UTC. Please ensure test infra is warmed.
Pete (platform): Confirmed I'll warm test infra and run warming hooks. I'll also create the release PR at 2026-02-11 23:45 UTC so reviewers have time.
Michael T.: Final checklist items for everyone:
- freeze merges to release/* at 2026-02-12 00:30 UTC
- changelog PRs in by 00:45 UTC
- release PR opened by Pete, reviewers pinged by 00:50 UTC
- canary 01:10 UTC (us), smoke 01:25 UTC (QA), full deploy 02:10 UTC (if green)
If you can't make these times, reply here now. Otherwise I'll send calendar invites and a final reminder 3 hours before. :bell:
Jen L.: I can do review but will be async until 00:00 UTC. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
Nora: I'll stay on for the APAC follow-up at 14:00 UTC.
Pete (platform): Creating release PR now and will ping reviewers.
Michael T.: Thanks all — sending calendar invites. I'll post a short changelog nudge in #general when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
